title: Noise wants to help everyday people become paid content creators | TechCrunch
summary: CEO Kafie said the company’s top creators make more than six figures a year, and the platform takes a fee from what brands pay creators once views are delivered. “Our top brands work with several thousand creators on autopilot,” he said.
